QuestInfo.name: [Hieizan Temple] Chasing the Boy
QuestInfo.0: It seems the boy has tricked you into doing something... not so good. But he seemed so nice! Chase after him to find out who's behind this.
QuestInfo.1: You chased after the boy and found the entrance to the Oni's lair at the #m811000019#. You have a feeling you'll find the boy inside.
QuestInfo.2: You witnessed the brainwashing of the alliance members at the entrance of #m811000020# and eliminated the sorcerer. You obtained the #i4034142##t4034142#, but the boy is nowhere to be found. Go back out to #m811000021#.
